questions.q: In which series did Kingpin make his debut in 1967?
questions.why: Wilson Fisk first showed up in The Amazing Spider-Man #50, so he began as a Spider-Man foe before Daredevil claimed him.

questions.q: Which actor played Kingpin in the 2003 film about the blind vigilante?
questions.why: Michael Clarke Duncan played Fisk in the 2003 Daredevil movie, reportedly bulking up by about forty pounds for the part.

questions.q: Who voiced Kingpin in the animated film Into the Spider-Verse (2018)?
questions.why: Liev Schreiber voiced the hulking Wilson Fisk, who runs the collider that opens the multiverse in that film.

questions.q: Starting in 1981 under Frank Miller, which hero became Kingpin's main adversary in the comics?
questions.why: Frank Miller shifted Fisk into Daredevil's book from issue #170, and he has been Matt Murdock's arch-nemesis ever since.

questions.q: In the 1970 stories, what villain name did Kingpin's son Richard use?
questions.why: Richard Fisk, after faking his death, returned as the Schemer in Amazing Spider-Man #83 to 85 to take on his father's rivals.

questions.q: Which artist drew the 1986 storyline Born Again, issues #227 to 233?
questions.why: David Mazzucchelli provided the art for Born Again, the arc in which Fisk methodically tears down Matt Murdock's life.

questions.q: In the comics, besides a laser, what does Kingpin's trick cane release?
questions.why: Fisk's cane can fire a laser pulse and also puff out sleeping gas, a gadget matched by his tie in some stories.

questions.q: In Charles Soule's run (2017 to 2018) on the blind vigilante's book, what public office does Kingpin win?
questions.why: Fisk ran on an anti-vigilante platform and won the mayoralty, giving him legal power over the city's costumed heroes.
He married Vanessa first; Typhoid Mary came later.

questions.q: Which classic Hollywood actor did John Romita Sr. base Kingpin's build on?
questions.why: Romita modelled Fisk's massive frame on character actor Sydney Greenstreet, along with Robert Middleton.
